{{nihongo|'''Kashikuri Shrine'''|加紫久利神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Shimosaba-chō, {{ill|Izumi, Kagoshima|Q15734|qid=Q15734}}, {{ill|Kagoshima Prefecture|Q15701|qid=Q15701}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} and its former rank was {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=prefectural shrine|qid=Q90139226}}. {{nihongo|'''Kashikuri Shrine'''|加紫久利神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Satsuma Province]].

== History ==
The founding date is unknown, but shrine tradition places it far back in the {{ill|Age of the gods (Japanese mythology)|Q3577055|qid=Q3577055}} and says it has roughly a 2,000-year history. According to 'Shikinaisha Chōsa Hōkoku,' however, this shrine was established in {{ill|Taihō (era)|Q1346269|qid=Q1346269|lt=Taihō}} 2 ({{ill|702|Q23497|qid=Q23497}}), at the same time as the founding of {{ill|Satsuma|Q227481|qid=Q227481}}, by transferring the three female deities of {{ill|Usa (宇佐)|Q22128861|qid=Q22128861}} to the foothills of {{ill|Mount Kashikuri|Q11584247|qid=Q11584247|lt=Mount Kashikuri}} on the Higo border. It further states this was done by Kashi no Kimi Watari, thought to be from Kashikuyari in Kamimike District, {{ill|Buzen|Q411745|qid=Q411745}}, who took part in the Taihō 2 campaign against the {{ill|Hayato people|Q1151764|qid=Q1151764}} and enshrined the deity of his homeland's {{ill|Otomi Shrine|Q11434509|qid=Q11434509}}. Kashi no Kimi, rewarded for service, was ordered to guard the Higo border after the war and settled here, naming the area Kashikuri after his home Kashikuyari. At the time, Buzen Kashikuyari became Suee-gō under local-administration reforms, and Satsuma Kashikuri likewise changed to a same-reading district name "Kariya-gō" due to main/branch-family relations, preserving the name in the '{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Wamyōshō}}'<ref>'Kadokawa Nihon Chimei Daijiten 46 Kagoshima Prefecture'</ref>.

In {{ill|Kōnin (era)|Q1373070|qid=Q1373070}} 14 ({{ill|823|Q29944|qid=Q29944}}), Kashikuri Shrine was fixed as the great shrine for {{ill|Satsuma|Q227481|qid=Q227481}} among Japan's 66 provinces.

At the summit is '''Yakoshi Shrine''', administered by this shrine. Because Yakoshi Shrine's annual festival is also March 4, the same as this shrine's spring festival, some relationship is suggested, though no clear tradition survives. It is also possible this shrine originally began as {{ill|Mountain worship|fa|کوه‌پرستی|ja|山岳信仰|ko|산악신앙|simple|Mountain worship|zh|山岳信仰|qid=Q93697439}} with Mount Kashikuri as its {{ill|Shintai|de|Shintai|el|Σίνταϊ|es|Shintai|fa|شین‌تای|fi|Shintai|fr|Shintai|hr|Shintai|id|Shintai|ja|神体|jv|Shintai|ko|신체 (신토)|mk|Шинтаи|pl|Go-shintai|pt|Shintai|ru|Синтай (синтоизм)|simple|Shintai|sr|Шинтаи|tr|Shintai|uk|Сінтай (синто)|zh|神體|qid=Q327532}}.

As a historically important shrine linked to the founding of Satsuma, it was strongly revered by the {{ill|Shimazu clan|Q1061406|qid=Q1061406}}, rulers of this region. The 21st head {{ill|Shimazu Yoshitaka|ja|島津吉貴|zh|島津吉貴|zh_min_nan|Simazu Yositaka|qid=Q11246537}} had it recognized as the {{ill|Sōja shrine|Q1107129|qid=Q1107129}} of {{ill|Satsuma Province|bcl|Probinsya nin Satsuma|be|Сацума (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Satsuma|cs|Provincie Sacuma|de|Provinz Satsuma|es|Provincia de Satsuma|fa|ولایت ساتسوما|fr|Province de Satsuma|gl|Provincia de Satsuma|id|Provinsi Satsuma|it|Satsuma (provincia)|ja|薩摩国|ko|사쓰마국|lt|Sacumos žemė|ms|Wilayah Satsuma|nl|Satsuma (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Satsuma|pt|Província de Satsuma|ru|Сацума (провинция)|simple|Satsuma Province|sk|Sacuma (provincia)|sr|Провинција Сацума|th|แคว้นซัตสึมะ|tr|Satsuma (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сацума|wuu|萨摩国|zh|薩摩國|zh_min_nan|Satuma-kok|zh_yue|薩摩國|qid=Q667475|lt=Sasshū}} and undertook construction of shrine buildings.
